brief.objective: Get the Bandit within 5 m of the Lady while never letting the Guard within 5 m.
brief.approach: Default brief: approach directly, evade the Guard when it closes inside the keep-out radius.

goal.rationale: The Guard sits 600 m along-track on the direct line to the Lady, so routing the Bandit with a radial offset to a waypoint just short of the Guard's track keeps the Bandit clear of its keep-out while still progressing toward the Lady.

The Guard is closing on the Bandit along the direct line near 40 m radial and 656 m along-track, so the Bandit should swing wide to a radial offset of about -300 m and stay more than 300 m from the Guard while still progressing toward the Lady.

The Guard is still moving toward the Bandit along the direct line (now near x=74 m, y=-706 m), so the Bandit should keep swinging to the -x side on the way to the Lady while holding at least 300 m from the Guard.

The Guard is now about 740 m out near x=59 m, so the Bandit should keep routing through the -x side at roughly 330 m clearance from the Guard's current track while closing on the Lady, and re-plan if the Guard's re-aimed path starts to cut that corridor.
